values.note: Reservations close 7 days before arrival; after that any open site is taken by registering in person at the campground on the day. Reservations need at least two nights (three on Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends). Check-in and check-out 3 pm.

booking.source: https://reservations.co.portage.wi.gov/parks/camping/dubay_park_campground/ ('must be made at least 7 days in advance'; 'YOU MUST SAME DAY REGISTER ... FOR ANY OPEN SITE'; 14 consecutive days); rules PDF 6-10-2020 (two-night minimum, 3 on holidays)

note: Portage County park on 600-acre Lake DuBay (Wisconsin River reservoir), 4501 County Rd E, Junction City (~13 mi NW of Stevens Point). The east end of the north loop (about sites 11-13) and the 32-36 spur look toward the lake through a shoreline tree strip; the rest are in pine woods. A seasonal park manager lives in the park. Boat ramp, fishing pier, sand beach. Distinct from the private Lake DuBay Shores Campground nearby. --Claude
summary: Reservation site (campground page, site search, 37 per-site pages), 2020 rules PDF, campground map and imagery read. Lakeview kept (sites ~40-45 m from shore behind a tree strip). County page link now redirects.
